nodes.text: Obtain 13C NMR spectra to gather information about the carbon framework

support.quote: I will begin by obtaining the 13C NMR spectra.

nodes.text: 13C NMR indicates aromatic carbons (160.80–124.85 ppm) and aliphatic carbons (57.20–16.60 ppm), suggesting a compound with both aromatic and aliphatic components

support.quote: The 13C NMR spectra provide chemical shift values that suggest the presence of aromatic carbons (160.80, 135.43, 130.70, 130.40, 128.70, 128.35, 124.85) and aliphatic carbons (57.20, 41.00, 39.20, 34.00, 24.56, 19.40, 16.60). This indicates a compound with both aromatic and aliphatic components.

nodes.text: Obtain proton NMR spectra to identify hydrogen environments and functional groups

support.quote: I should obtain the proton NMR spectra, which will provide information on the hydrogen environment and help identify functional groups.

nodes.text: 1H NMR confirms aromatic protons at 7.04 ppm and aliphatic signals (methyl and methylene groups), consistent with a structure containing aromatic rings and aliphatic chains

support.quote: The proton NMR spectra indicate the presence of aromatic protons (7.04 ppm), which align with the aromatic carbons observed in the 13C NMR. The signals at 1.12 ppm (doublet), 2.04 ppm (doublet of doublets), 2.21 ppm (singlet), 2.34 ppm (singlet), 2.70 ppm (doublet of doublets of quartets), and 4.01 ppm (doublet of doublets) suggest the presence of aliphatic groups, possibly including methyl and methylene groups.

nodes.text: Obtain HSQC NMR spectra to correlate carbon and hydrogen environments

support.quote: I will use the HSQC NMR spectra to correlate the carbon and hydrogen environments.

nodes.text: Search NMRShift database with SMILES CC(C)C1=CC=CC=C1C(=O)O

support.quote: I will search the NMRShift database using a potential SMILES string that fits these observations.

nodes.text: HSQC confirms aromatic protons correlating to aromatic carbons and aliphatic protons correlating to aliphatic carbons, consistent with a phenyl group and aliphatic chains

support.quote: The HSQC NMR spectra provide correlations between hydrogen and carbon environments, confirming the presence of aromatic protons (7.04 ppm) with corresponding aromatic carbons (128.7, 128.4, 130.4, 124.9 ppm). The aliphatic protons (1.12, 2.04, 2.21, 2.34, 2.70, 4.01 ppm) correlate with aliphatic carbons (16.6, 39.2, 19.4, 34, 41, 57.2 ppm).
